app.title: BIXI Demand Forecasting and Rebalancing
app.question: How many departures and arrivals should we expect at each station, and where should bicycles be redistributed?
app.station_names_note: Station names are shown in their original form.

pages.planned_step: Planned for step {step} of the build.

overview.description: Headline numbers, forecast status, and key findings for the selected stations.

trip_analysis.description: Hourly, daily, and seasonal patterns of departures and arrivals.

station_map.description: Interactive map of stations with trip volume, net flow, and forecast overlays.

forecasts.description: Hourly departure and arrival forecasts issued a day ahead, with 80% prediction intervals, compared with what actually happened.

rebalancing.description: Scenario analysis of redistribution plans under explicit assumptions about starting bike inventory and station capacity.

model_performance.description: Baselines versus machine-learning models, time-based backtests, and error analysis.

methodology.description: Data sources, station selection, modelling choices, assumptions, and limitations.

methodology.assumption_1: Observed trips are not the same as true demand: when a station is empty or full, unmet demand is never recorded.
methodology.assumption_2: Periods outside the operating season are excluded from modelling.
methodology.assumption_3: Rebalancing results depend on assumed starting inventory and station capacity; they are scenario estimates, not measured outcomes.
methodology.assumption_4: 24-hour forecasts use only information available at prediction time (weather forecasts, not observed weather).

BIXI publishes trip data after the fact, so the same pipeline will forecast 2026 once those trips are released.

forecasts.kpi_inside_help: Hours whose actual count fell inside the 80% prediction interval. About 80% is expected over many days.
forecasts.chart_caption: Blue line: forecast. Shaded band: 80% prediction interval. Black dots: what was observed.

forecasts.stations_title: Which stations will fill up or run low?
forecasts.stations_caption: Forecast net change (arrivals minus departures) for the chosen time of day, all 50 stations, sorted from the largest expected loss to the largest gain. This is the input to the rebalancing simulation.

rebalancing.not_run: No simulation results yet. Run python -m bixi.rebalancing to run the scenario analysis.
rebalancing.assumptions_body:
- Trucks carry **{capacity} bikes**, drive at **{speed} km/h** (with a detour factor), spend **{stop} min** per stop and **{per_bike} min** per bike.
- Rebalancing windows: **{windows}**. Moves planned at the start of a window take effect at its end; each plan prepares the stations for the hours until the next window.
- Dock counts come from BIXI's live feed; staffed overflow docking (valet) is ignored.
- Plans use the **day-ahead forecasts**; every day is scored with the flows that **actually** happened. {days} days, October 1 to November 14, 2025.
- Within an hour, departures and arrivals are netted, which understates problems at very busy stations.
rebalancing.kpi_reduction_help: Reduction in station-hours with no bike or no free dock, compared with no rebalancing, averaged over all days.
rebalancing.kpi_oracle_help: How much of the improvement a plan with perfect knowledge of the day would achieve, the forecast-based plan achieves.
rebalancing.compare_caption: Average per day for the chosen scenario. Lower is better. Even perfect foresight leaves many full hours: downtown stations receive more bikes in the morning peak than they have docks.
rebalancing.alt_compare: Stacked bar chart of empty and full station-hours per day for each strategy
rebalancing.sensitivity_title: How much do more trucks help?
rebalancing.sensitivity_caption: Reduction in problem hours with optimized routes planned from forecasts, by number of trucks and starting fill.
rebalancing.alt_sensitivity: Line chart of the reduction in problem hours by number of trucks, one line per starting fill
rebalancing.day_caption: Optimized routes planned from the forecasts, with stations {fill} full at midnight and {trucks} trucks.
rebalancing.no_moves: The plan moves no bikes in this window.
rebalancing.alt_map: Map of truck routes with pick-up and drop-off stations
rebalancing.map_legend: Lines: truck routes from and back to a central depot. Red circles: bikes picked up; blue circles: bikes dropped off; size shows the number of bikes.
rebalancing.alt_inventory: Line chart of the bikes at one station through the day, with and without rebalancing
rebalancing.inventory_caption: Grey: no rebalancing. Blue: {strategy}. At 0 departures fail; at the dashed line arrivals cannot dock.
